videos.headline: SEC Now's keys to success as No. 1 Texas takes on No. 14 Tennessee
videos.description: SEC Network's Gene Chizik and Fozzy Whittaker point to the line of scrimmage for the Vols and consistency for the Longhorns ahead of the elite SEC matchup in Knoxville.

videos.headline: Tennessee's Heupel describes Texas, Manning's 'competitive makeup'
videos.description: As the No. 14 Vols prepare to host the No. 1 Longhorns in their SEC opener, Josh Heupel discusses QB Arch Manning's resilience and the hype surrounding their matchup.
